name: deallocate_and_ascend
declaration: unsafe fn deallocate_and_ascend < A : Allocator + Clone > (self , alloc : A ,) -> Option < Handle < NodeRef < marker :: Dying , K , V , marker :: Internal > , marker :: Edge > >
parent: NodeRef < marker :: Dying , K , V , marker :: LeafOrInternal >
documentation:
Similar to `ascend`, gets a reference to a node's parent node, but also
 deallocates the current node in the process. This is unsafe because the
 current node will still be accessible despite being deallocated.
rules: After this call deallocates the current node, the current node must not be accessed, even though it remains accessible.
